# Third-party source

This directory vendors source used to build and integrate Herdr Pet.

- `avatar-lab/` is based on `smontlouis/bible-strong-avatar-lab` at
  `8207a2d6aad4b8feefce8cccb10687ce0122724d`, with the runtime integration
  changes documented in the repository's `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- `herdr/` is based on `herdrdev/herdr` at
  `d76657f2c7fc18dcce3b9af43842c8afaba1646b`.

The upstream Git metadata is intentionally not included. License files remain
with each vendored project.
